about_the_game:
Story Outline

The eggs at Old Eagle's supermarket were snapped up in a flash. He called on Big Chicken to bring more eggs, and Big Chicken promised to deliver a massive supply within three months. To achieve this, a elite force was dispatched to raid Panda's home for the eggs.

Game Features

  • Side-scrolling Action Beat 'em Up: Players control either a panda or a tiger to fend off all egg-stealing birds.

  • Real-Time Strategy: Players can return to their base at any time to use eggs to upgrade their strength. Meanwhile, the bird faction will also use stolen eggs to strengthen themselves. The side that first occupies all territories wins.

  • Random Skill Tree: Adds immense replayability to the game.

  • Character Development with Personality: Unique and memorable characters.

  • Dual Endings: Two possible outcomes based on player choices.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(r) Core (TM)2 CPU -T7200 @ 2.50 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ATI Mobility Raedon X1600 / Nvidia GeForce 8600M GT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard

short_description: A side-scrolling beat-'em-up roguelike built on a real-time strategy framework. Battle to obtain eggs, upgrade your base and gear, and ultimately repel all invaders to destroy the enemy base and win.

English*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*
